comment: Another dollar on top and still no real lossless on Windows or Android, so I'm not seeing what the extra money buys for sound. I'm not leaving over a buck since the recs and my library are still here, but someone should explain what this is paying for.

Ugh, another price hike and my playlists still play random stuff instead of the songs I picked. Is anyone else seeing this? Not paying for Premium anyway, but the app keeps making it harder to enjoy what I already have.
lol great, paying more for something that still doesnt stop the bug on my phone. tried reinstalling everything again. hopefully fixed soon but im not paying more til it actually works

Price goes up again and the recs still repeat the same stuff. I already pay for YouTube Premium which includes YouTube Music, so this is starting to not make sense. Keeping Spotify for jam for now but I'm watching the exit door.
Still cheaper than buying the albums, honestly no complaints here. Its a bit pricey but I've been paying since forever and the ad free listening and downloads are worth it for me.

I love Spotify and I've been paying for over ten years, so a buck isn't going to change anything for me. The recs are still the same top-40 loops, but I make my own playlists anyway. Can't see myself going back to Apple Music.

Lol, price goes up again. I'm still off Premium since I cancelled over AI slop in my Discover Weekly, and this just reminds me the money doesn't reach artists anyway. Raising prices while artists get pennies. Great stuff.

Premium goes up again and I still cant find the setting I want. features keep disappearing and the app keeps getting more bloated with ads. Absolute garbage at this price. Staying for crossfade and spicetify but I'm losing my mind.

They're jacking the price up while AI slop sits in my Discover Weekly and artists get nothing. I already left once for this, and no, I'm not paying more to be fed fake artists. Actually cracking down on fake music is the only thing that might bring me back.
Duo going up to 18.99, meh. Discover Weekly every Monday is still my thing and new features eventually show up, so it's well worth the wait for me. Not a huge deal.

Spotify raises prices again and artists still get pennies for their streams. Paying more into the money vacuum while the CEO is a billionaire. I'll keep paying because I see it as supporting artists, but I'm buying music directly more and more.

Family plan going to 21.99 while features like lossless and AI playlists are region locked for us. Same price, fewer features, and the discovery stuff keeps getting worse. Worth its weight in gold for my parents, but this doesn't feel fair.
Price went up, whatever. I'm on Bluetooth and 320 kbps is fine, nobody can hear the difference anyway. Not losing sleep over a dollar.

Student plan going from 5.99 to 6.99 hurts a bit. Still cheaper than full price and I'm keeping the Hulu. But I'm stressing about re-verifying, and about losing Hulu when the four year discount runs out.
Premium is still the best deal around. A dollar more is nothing for nearly all the music ever made. Worth it for me, and it's how I pay the artists. Two cost increases and I'm still here.
Premium going up again for features that should be free? Why do I have to pay for basic stuff. I'm on the free plan anyway and it's ridiculous that the ads and skip limits are still there.
Spotify going up again, and Apple Music is cheaper with better audio. I'm used to Spotify and all my shared playlists are here, so I'm stuck with it for now, but I'm getting close to switching.

Price goes up AGAIN and shuffle still plays the same 10-15 songs over and over. Smart shuffle is broken and free shuffle worked better. Not paying more for this. Staying only because my 9000 song playlist would be a nightmare to move.

Another price rise on top of the billing mess I'm already fighting. Support keeps sending the same copy paste reply. I'm keeping Premium until the billing period ends, but I want a clear answer on whether the new price hits me mid cycle.

more price hikes while the app keeps breaking after updates and songs wont play the next track. support is useless. already cancelled premium once. amazon music is cheaper and has playlists spotify is missing, kinda tempted to just switch.

Family plan going up and the discography is still gone. still a PITA. the artist button got fixed so thanks for that, but this price hike is annoying when the lyrics screen looks so fucking ugly. hope this gets fixed soon or im back to youtube music.

Price going up, and the podcast side is still a mess with the New Episodes folder gone and episodes playing in reverse. I love the UI and my playlists are here so I'm not leaving yet, but I'd like that money to go toward fixing podcasts.
Premium going up is annoying but $12 is still a steal, and the family plan is cheap per person. Worth every penny for podcasts, audiobooks and music in one app with Spotify Connect. Not switching.

Family plan going up again. The price per person is still ok but it keeps creeping. Still no lossless on family, and the address stuff already locked me out once. Not dropping it yet, but I'll be checking Amazon Music if it goes past this.

Price up but the queue bugs and songs restarting are still happening, lol. lossless sounds amazing on my speakers but this update sucks. Still paying, but if the playback stuff isnt fixed im moving to apple music. thank god for the logout fix.

Paying more for Premium and I still get unskippable Spotify ads in my podcasts? That's double dipping. I already moved my shows to Apple Podcasts. Premium is music only so these ads are a broken promise. Stop it.

Price bump is annoying but worth it to me. Moving years of playlists elsewhere is a huge pain so I'll keep my subscription. Anyone know a playlist sync tool that still works? Mostly want the search and multi device sync.

Premium going up and free spotify is still ass with ads and no song choosing. just pay for premium I guess, or buy youtube premium. $12 a month is fine for the music but I'm not thrilled about paying for stuff that used to be free.
